rule: A statement may be tagged machine-checked only if its checker holds and the checker's scope equals the statement's scope; checked-scope-only if its checker holds on a narrower scope; otherwise pending-human-review.

statements.statement: S1 on every joint distribution over the finite model families B12, B3 and T2
S1: P(change) <= sum(e_i + u_i) and P(deny->allow) <= sum(e_i), for any finite reachable set, sufficient contract and sensor
S2 for nested sensed-field sets on the finite model families

S3's global deny-ward condition is exactly the absence of a deny-to-allow vertex, on the finite model families
S3: if unknown denies and the configuration is deny-ward (global), then P(deny->allow) = 0
N6: (a) the S1 unsafe bound is attained with disjoint errors; (b) joint errors in an AND contract defeat the v1 directional bound while S1 holds
